title: Iran’s President Arrives at UNGA Seeking to Avoid More Sanctions
summary: Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the General Assembly looking to prevent the imposition of sanctions on his country, this time from the United Nations Security Council.

title: For the first time in nearly 6 decades, a Syrian president steps up to speak at the U.N.
summary: Turning the page on decades of distance, Syria's President Ahmad al-Sharaa addressed the U.N. General Assembly, marking the first time any president from his country has done so in almost 60 years.

title: Canada and Indonesia Ink Trade Deal Amid US Tariff Upheaval
summary: Indonesia and Canada agreed to a deal to lower trade barriers and ease investment procedures, part of efforts by both nations to expand global economic ties in the wake of higher US tariffs.

title: Air Canada lowers full-year guidance as hit from strike estimated at $375M
summary: MONTREAL — Air Canada has lowered its guidance for the year after taking a hit from the flight attendant strike that took place earlier this summer.
